summary: Operator's pages confirm the single 50-amp full-hookup RV site ($85) and the $40 self-contained boondocking lot (fees as recorded 2026-10-16), showers and spring-water spigot, and own-site booking with a no-refund policy. Season not stated.
flags: Price gate (private, not stayed at by the family): the only RV site with hookups is 'Starting at $85.00 per night'; the cheaper option is the $40 'Boondocking RV Site', an unlevel upper parking lot with no amenities. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Shenandoah NP 74 km, Gettysburg 98 km, Washington 133 km).

Criteria: RV camping looks like an afterthought here: one hookup site plus a parking lot, beside glamping, tent sites, a riverside wedding/event venue and a full-campground rental for 65 guests. 'NO pets allowed' and every reservation is non-refundable.
